title: One Rook, Two Jobs
setup: Black's rook on a8 is guarding the bishop on a5, and it is also the only piece covering the eighth rank.
hint: Nothing needs to be given away. Take something, and watch which job the rook decides to drop.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxa5}} is a plain trade, bishop for bishop, but it asks the rook on a8 a question it cannot answer. Recapture with {{Rxa5}} and the eighth rank is empty behind it: {{Re8#}}, because from a5 the rook reaches neither e8 nor f8. Leave the bishop instead and the rook keeps the back rank, but White is simply a piece up. Nothing was offered and nothing was forced. The rook had two jobs and one move.
